thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Spike detected - /v1/chat (us-central) high p95/p99 latency + retry loop. inflight queue 9.6k, errors 4xx/5xx rising. Paging on-call.
Julia (oncall): Picking up. Which services are red? Dashboards show heavy retry churn on chat-stream and embedding-bulk endpoints.
Sam (runtime): Looks like backlog due to several long-lived streaming sessions plus a few high-seq jobs holding KV locks. Circuit-breaker counters trending toward trip for runtime-group us-central-a.
Nina (ops): Any obvious customer causing burst?
Micah (support): Customer X (ad-network) has a sudden traffic spike hitting embeddings-bulk; Customer Y (analytics) also showing retries. Both on pay tier.
Julia (oncall): Immediate plan: 1) enable emergency token-bucket throttles for public traffic; 2) turn off streaming on chat for non-VIP to reduce long-lived connections; 3) lower runtime-group concurrency and bump shedding aggressiveness; 4) grant VIP exemptions for Customer X so their jobs can finish. Who can run control-plane changes?
Sam (runtime): I'll make the runtime config changes. Patching in flight_concurrency and shedding params on the control plane and the runtime configmap to avoid hot kv contention.
Sam (runtime): Commands I will use:
```bash
# throttle public traffic to preserve capacity
curl -X POST https://control.redwood/api/v1/traffic/policy \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"scope":"public","bucket_rate_per_min":6000}'

# disable streaming for non-vip chat route
curl -X POST https://control.redwood/api/v1/routes/chat-stream/config \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"streaming_enabled":false, "scope":"non-vip"}'

# patch runtime concurrency and shedding for us-central group
curl -X PATCH https://control.redwood/api/v1/runtimes/us-central-a \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"max_concurrency":64, "shedding_threshold":0.75, "request_timeout_ms":9000}'
```
Nina (ops): I'll prepare a temporary VIP exemption for Customer X. ops-bot, please apply when approved.
ops-bot: Please confirm: `ops-bot grant-exempt customer-x 2h vip-exempt`
Julia (oncall): Confirmed. Grant it.
ops-bot: Grant applied. Customer X exempted for 2h.
Sam (runtime): Making the changes now. Rolling updates to runtime group to avoid mass restart. Applying configmap patch to bypass prefix-kv caching for long-prefix requests to prevent lock contention.
platform-bot: Config patch queued for rollout to 3 pods at a time.
(45s later) Sam (runtime): Throttle live and streaming disabled for non-vip. Inflight dropped from 9.6k -> 2.9k. p99 down from 3.9s -> 1.5s. Circuit breakers backing off.
Micah (support): Customer X confirms their long jobs are still running (thanks to exemption). Customer Y reported fewer timeouts.
Julia (oncall): Good. Keep monitoring. Let's also enable temporary rate limit headers so clients see `Retry-After` and avoid blind retries.
Sam (runtime): Pushed `X-RateLimit-Mode: token-bucket` and `X-Retry-After` on 429s. Also toggled dynamic-shedding to drop low-priority background requests automatically.
Nina (ops): Observability note: added debug logs for KV lock durations and streaming session counts.
Sam (runtime): Adding a safety measure: if queue depth > 5k for more than 2m, flip to aggressive shedding and return 503 for non-critical routes. Implemented via runtime policy flag `auto_shed_on_queue=true`.
Julia (oncall): Handoff: Sam you'll own mid-window monitoring and rollback plan. Nina you'll coordinate customer comms with Micah. I'll stay on-call for escalation.
Sam (runtime): Acknowledged. I've also scheduled a gradual rollback plan: when p99 < 2s for 20 continuous minutes, we will restore streaming for non-vip in 25% increments and increase max_concurrency to 96 then 128 in steps.
(20m later) platform-bot: Alert: queue depth stable at ~1.1k, p99 1.3s. No new 5xx spikes.
Micah (support): Support now sending a short advisory to impacted customers explaining temporary throttles and VIP exemptions.
Nina (ops): I'll keep the VIP exemption until we confirm long-run stability, but will set auto-expire at 2h as planned.
Sam (runtime): Starting staged rollback: enable streaming at 25% for non-vip. max_concurrency -> 96. Observing metrics.
(5m increments) Sam (runtime): No regressions at 25% -> proceeding to 50% -> 75%. Reached full restore without spike.
Julia (oncall): Reverting token-bucket throttle back to baseline. Confirming all runtime flags back to normal except added observability logs.
Sam (runtime): Done. Final metrics: inflight 720, p99 0.95s, error% <0.5%.
Julia (oncall): Closing alert. Assign postmortem to Sam + Nina. Action items: - add per-model dynamic_concurrency caps - implement auto-exempt flow for pre-authorized VIPs to avoid manual ops bottleneck - test streaming disable as automated mitigation in chaos tests.
Sam (runtime): Will file INC-2027 timeline + config diffs. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
